Use the terminology that best fits your current Goal Setting material: relevant and realistic both invite a Wise Mind check about meaning and feasibility.

Before setting a goal, consider what you hope to gain, what effort it may cost, and which signs would tell you the step is worthwhile. Afterward, use the [Activity & Mood Log](/tool-finder/activity-mood-log/) to notice what actually happens.
